svg.title: The project journey
svg.desc: Animated timeline of the seven project phases: Capture, Discovery, Definition, Plan, Build, Delivery and adoption, Closure. Each phase gets an approval check. Outputs: project map, decisions, achievements, which flow to the journal, the CV and offer fit analysis.
svg.text: Seven phases. Each one closes only with your approval.
Achievements flow into your journal, then into tailored CVs and job-offer fit analysis.
